description: Send 1-50 threat report entries to the tracker their route points at (or `destination`). One ticket per threat per report; a repeat returns already_filed. dry_run=true returns the exact tickets without sending; a preview with public_repository=true goes to a public repository, visible to anyone. Error codes: permission_missing, role_missing, destination_not_found, already_filed, rate_limited, assignee_unmapped, no_route, no_entry, not_found, invalid, no_company, tracker_error, filed_unrecorded, outcome_unknown, not_attempted, not_configured, tracker_unreachable, unsupported. filed_unrecorded and outcome_unknown mean the ticket may already exist in the tracker; not_attempted means the item was not sent.

destination.description: {provider, channel_ref, destination} to override the route

name: file_threat_tickets
title: Send threats to a tracker
